Application

Source: R/app.R
App-class.Rd

An App owns the widget tree (through its Screen), the event queue, timers, key bindings, focus and the terminal driver. Create one with app() and start it with run().

Event loop

Each tick of the loop waits for input (or the next timer), turns input into events, fires due timers, dispatches every queued event and then, if any widget was invalidated, repaints the screen once: the new frame is diffed against the previous one and only changed cells are written.

Event dispatch

An event goes to its target widget (key events: the focused widget) and bubbles up through the ancestors to the app. At each widget the on_<type> method runs, then handlers added with widget$on(), then - for key events - the widget's key bindings. At the app, handlers added with app$on() / on() run, then app bindings. event$stop() stops propagation.

Public fields

title

Optional application title.

reduce_motion

NULL (follow the option / environment variable), TRUE or FALSE: reduce decorative animation? See motion_reduced().

clipboard

Text copied by widgets (Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X in inputs). This is the app's own clipboard, not the operating system's.

Active bindings

screen

The current Screen.

screens

The screen stack, bottom first.

focused

The focused widget, or NULL.

theme

The termr_theme() (assign a theme or a theme name).

stylesheets

The stylesheets of the app.

hovered

The widget under the mouse pointer, or NULL.

size

Terminal size: c(width =, height =).

running

Is the app running?

last_paint

Instrumentation of the last repaint: screen cells, repainted cells, dirty rectangles, whether it was a full repaint and the ANSI bytes written. For benchmarks and debugging.

profile_last_frame

Optional timings and structural counters; enable with options(termr.profile = TRUE). Times are milliseconds.

frame_stats

Number of full and incremental repaints and of layout passes so far.

frame

The last rendered ScreenBuffer.

App$new()

Create an app. See app().

Usage

App$new(
  ...,
  bindings = list(),
  actions = list(),
  title = NULL,
  mouse = TRUE,
  stylesheet = NULL,
  theme = "default",
  debug = FALSE,
  reduce_motion = NULL
)

Arguments

...

Widgets, on() handlers and bind() bindings.

bindings

A list of bind() bindings.

actions

A named list of functions function(app).

title

Optional title.

mouse

Enable mouse input?

stylesheet

A stylesheet(), stylesheet text or a file path (or a list of them).

theme

A termr_theme() or the name of a built-in theme.

debug

Bind F12 to the debug overlay?

reduce_motion

TRUE to turn decorative animation off, NULL to follow options(termr.reduce_motion) / the TERMR_REDUCE_MOTION environment variable.

App$run()

Run the app until it exits. Restores the terminal on exit, on error and on interrupt.

Usage

App$run(driver = NULL)

Arguments

driver

A terminal driver; detected automatically by default.

Returns

The value passed to exit(), invisibly.

App$exit()

Ask the app to stop after the current event.

Usage

App$exit(value = NULL)

Arguments

value

Value returned by run().

App$clipboard_write()

Copy text to the clipboard. The app clipboard (app$clipboard) is always set; when system = TRUE and the terminal supports OSC 52 the text is also sent to the system clipboard (write-only: termr never reads the system clipboard). Long text is truncated to 100 kB for the terminal.

Usage

App$clipboard_write(text, system = TRUE)

Arguments

text

A string.

system

Also write to the system clipboard?

Returns

TRUE (invisibly) if the text was sent to the terminal.

App$capture_mouse()

Send all mouse events to widget (even outside its region) until release_mouse() or the next button release. Used for drags that start elsewhere, e.g. splitters.

Usage

widget

A mounted widget.

App$request_repaint()

Schedule a repaint at the end of the current tick.

Usage

App$request_repaint(widget = NULL, full = is.null(widget), layout = TRUE)

Arguments

widget

The widget that changed, if known. Without it the next repaint redraws everything; with it only the rows of changed widgets are repainted when the layout did not change.

full

Force a full repaint?

layout

Does the change possibly affect sizes or positions? When FALSE and nothing else changed the layout pass is skipped.
